findings.message: Independent review completed in split steps due to intermittent empty responses from the reviewer model; every check question was answered explicitly by the release-reviewer agent.
Index note atlas-incidents-index contains only bare wikilink lines, no prose; no duplicated note ids.

All 19 wikilink targets resolve: 18 ATLAS case-study notes under Famous AI incidents/ plus mitre-atlas at Norms & Frameworks/mitre-atlas.md; link resolution also machine-verified by the deterministic preview.
Manifest declares fast lane with no strict triggers; ADD-only change of one index file; empty evidence-lock legitimate for pure navigation.
The reviewer model returned unreliable wikilink counts during testing (10/12 vs 19 actual); counts were re-verified deterministically, structural judgements only relied on the agent.
Review grants no approval; human hash-bound approval remains a separate decision.
